paragraphs: He is mentioned in Chullin 58b, raising an objection to Rav Ashi; Dikdukei Soferim reads Huna bar Mar Avya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The William Davidson digital text of Chullin 58b writes Rav Huna Mar bar Chiyya, without a second Rav before Chiyya. Hyman’s full heading and his reported Dikdukei Soferim alternative Huna bar Mar Avya are retained.

The actual Davidson Chullin 58b paragraph has Rav Huna Mar bar Chiyya addressing Rav Ashi, without a second Rav title before Chiyya. Hyman’s fully written Rav Chiyya heading stays distinct, and the Huna bar Mar Avya alternative remains his Dikdukei Soferim report, not a freshly collated apparatus. The current note is retained verbatim.
